notes.title: Tutorial Update & Hotfixes
notes.content:
Hi everyone! You may have noticed a few updates were sent out this week. Here is the change log for everything that was fixed/added.

- Added Tutorial/Guide at the start of the campaign
- Fixed re-calling units by selecting through the UI
- Fixed next-turn campaign button disappearing after losing first city and reloading campaign
- Fixed UI blocking issue for low resolution displays
- Performance Improvements when a large amount of rag dolls are on screen

If any bugs/complaints come up please make a report and I will address it ASAP.
With that being said, thank you all for a successful launch week!

notes.title: Private Playtest and Development Updates
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
We will be doing a private playtest leading up to release. If you would like to join (you and a friend will get a free copy of the game and of course pre-release access!) please join our new discord server: 
Click here to join!

Our numbers for this play test are obviously restricted, however the number of participants will vary so if you are interested in a free copy and getting a voice in how the game is developed please join the server.

As for development progress the following has been completed:
- Campaign mode and UI has been finalized
- Battle upgrades have been added (special boosts for your units can be applied)
- LOTS and LOTS of bug fixes in anticipation of release.

notes.title: Devlog 1 - Multiplayer & Gore
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Won't go into way too much detail but some major progress with Vae Victis has been made!

Multiplayer
Multiplayer has been fully integrated with the steam networking api, meaning we were able to play a few PVP matches successfully over Steam! I originally anticipated this to take a lot more time then it did but the conversion from our original networking solution to the steamworks api was very simple to do. I also converted all of the netcode to align with changes made to the single player methods. Meaning if a change is made for single player, that change will translate over to multiplayer. So what does this mean? Release might be possible way sooner then I originally thought. 

Small note, multiplayer isn't completely stable it still needs to be tested more thoroughly. However anyone can pick the game up and play multiplayer now.

Gore
The gore system for the game has been expanded to allow for crawling soldiers that leave blood trails, exploding body parts and more! Don't worry, if you're squeamish there will be a way to disable this!

Take a look below to check it out!

These are team specific special units that have a very high cost. They are basically your hero units that are very strong and have special abilities. A single one of these units could take on an army of regular units.

Development timeline.
In short, I plan to release the game within the range of 8 to 15 months from today. Everything is subject to change so the release date is not concrete yet. I also have been looking into working with a publisher which may drastically alter our timeline. With that being said the game is in a very playable state right now and technically could be released as a barebones product, but that isn't the goal of this project.
